# Synopsis: *Vengeance*
### Book Three of The Shadow War Chronicles

**Author**: Raymond Bayly  
**Series**: *The Shadow War Chronicles* (Book 3 of 9)  
**Genre**: Military Sci-Fi / Space Opera / Techno-Thriller  
**Length**: ~133,873 words · 23 Chapters  
**Formats Available**: DOCX, KPF, Markdown  

---

## Part I: Retail Back Cover Blurb

> *The speakers on the bridge came alive with a low, mocking laughter that froze Captain Blake Campbell in his tracks.*
> 
> *“Oh Captain… did you think I was done with you?” hissed a voice that shouldn’t have been alive.*
> 
> *Blake stared at the holo-projector as a grotesque, bandaged figure resolved in the flickering light. “You’re dead,” Blake whispered, his voice trembling before erupting into a raw fury. “Vengeance! I will kill you!”*
> 
> *The synthetic warlord only chuckled. “Oh, I am not even close to done with you, my friend. By the way… say hi to my new friend.”*
> 
> *Another holographic image resolved on the bridge. A small, terrified face that brought Blake to his knees.*
> 
> *“Daddy?”*

***

extra.section_header: He fought across the galaxy to save Earth. Now the nightmare has followed him home.
